title: Rebase Provider Hub onto the canonical single-root repository and complete deterministic verification

github_evidence: PR #13 merged the single project root, package root, and version authority as commit 59e102f08904cd408a9d993f7b537b4e513c8f5e.
PR #12 contains the original Provider Hub candidate but predates the repository-layout migration and has been closed as superseded.
Owner requested a CC-Switch-style page where registration and credential supply are the only manual steps.

objective: Deliver a loopback-only provider registry, OS-vault credential adapter, model discovery probes, secure CLI, and responsive switchboard page on the canonical single-root repository without attaching any provider to LivingSystem cognition.
forbidden_changes: Do not attach a selected provider to RuntimeConfig.provider, Planner, CognitiveEngine, or LivingSystem action selection.
Do not store credentials in Git, Notion, SQLite, provider_hub.json, browser storage, URLs, logs, issues, or pull requests.
Do not accept provider credentials through the browser page.
Do not enable automatic paid fallback or assign write or canonical truth authority to a provider.
Do not change identity, ET004 behavior, policy gates, owner approval, promotion, rollback, or kill authority.
Do not implement account rotation, quota evasion, trial abuse, or provider-terms bypass.

commands: python -m ruff check source/src source/tests source/scripts
conditions: The provider page is served only by the existing loopback WLS server.
Provider APIs require an ephemeral same-origin UI session.
Browser routes reject credential-bearing request bodies.
Credentials are delegated to an OS vault adapter or process-scoped environment variable and never persisted in provider metadata.
Remote custom endpoints require HTTPS; loopback HTTP remains allowed.
Model probes block redirects, cap timeout and response size, sanitize errors, and retain no credential value.
Provider selection requires enabled state, configured credential, and a successful probe.
Provider selection remains candidate-only and reports runtime_attached false.
All focused and full regression gates pass on Ubuntu and Windows under Python 3.11 and 3.13.
evidence_required: manual owner-host Windows Credential Manager and one real provider probe before provider admission

stop_conditions: Stop if persistent credential storage requires plaintext files.
Stop if the browser must receive or store a credential.
Stop if implementation requires runtime attachment before provider admission.
Stop if a custom remote endpoint cannot be bounded to HTTPS or owner-approved loopback.
Stop if the single-root repository invariant is violated.
dependencies: PR #13 merged and canonical single-root invariant active
owner supplies credentials only after registering with each provider

tests: Focused Provider Hub tests passed on the first Ubuntu workflow attempt before the platform stopped starting jobs.
The full suite initially failed because this packet violated EVOLUTION_PACKET.schema.json; the packet is now schema-conformant and requires a fresh run.
unknowns: Fresh exact-head CI is pending because GitHub Actions jobs are currently terminating before any step starts and expose no logs.
No real provider credential exists in CI.
Windows Credential Manager behavior remains owner-host pending.
Current free-tier limits and supplier data-use policies remain external and changeable.
No provider is admitted to canonical WLS cognition in this target.
output_contract.next_action: Rerun exact-head CI when GitHub Actions can start jobs. If green, merge the candidate switchboard, then perform one owner-host vault and model-list probe before creating a READ_ONLY_TRIAL admission packet.

handoff.summary: Provider Hub was rebuilt from current main after the repository-layout migration; its evolution packet is now schema-conformant and server compatibility was preserved.
handoff.blocker: Fresh CI jobs currently terminate before any workflow step starts; owner-host credential-vault verification also remains pending.
